caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Topped with shredded cabbage and nori, it sits in a blue-and-white patterned bowl on a wooden table, bathed in warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with crispy, browned edges and visible fat marbling.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough, uneven surface.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and shredded white toppings.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale, translucent, slightly curved strips with a glossy, moist surface.
Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern and raised rim, glossy finish, ornate detailing.
